title: tc-meter-row
description: A label, a percentage and a tiny bar on one line, with a word and a mark when it's getting full.

label.description: What's being measured; it names the meter, even when `compact` hides it

value.description: How much is used, from 0 to `max`

valueText.description: Text to show in place of the percentage, such as "812 of 1,000"

warnAt.description: The fraction of `max` where it starts to warn

dangerAt.description: The fraction of `max` where it turns to danger

interactive.description: Makes the row a button that fires tc-open

compact.description: Hides the label from sight, leaving the percentage and bar

bare.description: Drops the tray and shadow, for a row that sits in something else's surface
